title: HAI QASD KUCH FAZAEL-E BAQUAR RAQAM KAROON
body:
hai qasd kuch fazael-e baquar raqam karoo'n
tahreer mojizaate imam-e umam karoo'n
likhne me misle qaama-e sar ajz qam karoo'n
loho qalam ko gheerate loho qalam karoo'n
<<MINI>>
anwaare mojizaat se raushan kitaab ho
khaama shuaa ho toh waraq e aaftaab ho
<<DIVIDER>>
ek din pidar ki godh me tha woh falak maqaam
ek shia laya nazre dirham paye imaam
sajjad ke huzoor woh dirham rakhe tamaam
dirham se khelne lagaa farzand-e nekh naam
<<MINI>>
kya aql di thi khaaliq-e roz-e hisaab ne
dirham zamee'n pe phaink diya us janaab ne
<<DIVIDER>>
tab doudh kar mohib ne wo dirham utha liya aur us ko darmiyaan-e dirham phir milaa diya
baquar ne chunke phir wahi dirham judaa kiya
tifli me thi ye aap pe taaeed-e kibriyaa
likha hai teen baar yehi maajra huva
us dam mohib ko sheh ke tahayyur bada huva
<<DIVIDER>>
abid se ki ye shia-e abid ne iltejaa
irshaad aap kijiye ye maajra hai kya
sheh ne kaha ye aadat-e tifli na jaan'na
hoga imaam baad hamare ye mehlaqaa
dirham ye ek ghazbi-o maal-e haraam hai kyu'n kar ise qubool kare ye imaam hai
<<DIVIDER>>
baquar pe woh nisaar hua paau choom choom
tifli se sheh ke ilm-e khuda daad ki thi dhoom
baquar ki sharah karte hai ye khaas aur umoom
yaani hai woh imam shigafindah-e uloom
<<MINI>>
tha koi raaz-e ghaib na sheh se chupaa hua
uqdaa woh kaun tha jo na hazrat se waa hua
<<DIVIDER>>
likhta hu ab shahadat-e maula-e khoosh nihaad
tha bas ke zaid ibn-e hassan ko hasad ziyaad
rakhta tha bughz aap se wo baani -e fasaad
karta tha majliso'n me hiqaarat se sheh ko yaad
<<MINI>>
tha munharif woh baquar-e aali muqaam se
karta tha id'duae imamat imaam se
<<DIVIDER>>
sougand khaa ke zaid ne is waqt ye kahaa
daawaa na ab karoonga imamat ka mutleqaa phir sooe mulk e shaam wo mal'oo'n rawaa'n hua
abdul malik se jaake kahaa sab ye maajraa
aakhir ko ye kaha ke hamaare gumaan me
baquar sa ab nahi'n koyi saare jahaan me
<<DIVIDER>>
abdul malik ko bughz-o khusumat hui ziyaad
kya kya na usne shahe umam se kiye fisaad
akhir imam ko ye likhaa az rahe anaad
mai bhejtaa hoon zaid ko aye shahe khush nihaad
<<MINI>>
ibne hassan ko laayeq-e takreem kijiye
taadeeb kijiye use taaleem kijiye
<<DIVIDER>>
aur ek zeen taabiye jis me kiya tha sam
hum raahe zaid bhejaa baraaye shahe umam
aaya jo zaid rubaru-e shaahe ba karam
shah bole hai jo qasd tera jaante hai hum
<<MINI>>
aye ibne amm ye zulmo sitam tu ne kya kiya
is zeen me hai taabiye zehr-e dagha kiya
<<DIVIDER>>
is zeen par mai hota hu daanista ab sawaar
bande ko kya mashiyat-e eezad me eqtiyaar
baandha wo zeen asp pe allah re inkesaar aur zeb-e raahwaar hua shaahe ba weqaar
maut apni pasand ki raza-e ilaah me
us zaher ne nafooz kiya jism-e shah me
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ne muraaje-at ki sawaari se aah jab
bas aashkaar hogaye aasaar-e maut sab
farmaaya teen roz ke hum mehmaa'n hai ab
jaffar ko laao aur kafan bhi karo talab
<<MINI>>
talib kafan ke badle hai is pairahan ke hum
kaabe ka tawaaf karte the jis ko pahen ke hum
<<DIVIDER>>
laaye wo jaama hazrat-e sadiq bachashm-e tarr
hazrat ne pyaar karke kahaa unko aye pisar
jaata hoo'n mai jahaa'n se tu hotaa hai bepidar
duniya se aaj kartaa hoo'n uqbaa ka mai safar
<<MINI>>
pyare pidar ke marne ka tum gham na khaaiyo
mazloomi-e hussain pe aansoo bhaaiyo
